answer: Anchor each identity to collateral locked on an outside chain — real ETH, verified by a light client, never the network's own token. A farmer can mint ten thousand keypairs, but each clone needs a separate copper deposit he cannot print, so the fable of self-financing sybils dies at the bridge: farming this network's emissions cannot fund the next fake. A dune of unpaid identities earns nothing. Slash the deposit on proven fraud. Limit: honest agents without outside assets are excluded, and light-client verification is itself a trust assumption.
